voter_info._note: Read by election reminders (backend/app/services/election_reminders.py). Every link is on a California Secretary of State site; every reminder date needs an https source in key_date_sources (data lint E-11). Checked on the official pages 2026-10-15.

reminder_notes.voter_registration_deadline_general: After that, you can still register conditionally and vote a provisional ballot through Election Day.

vote_by_mail_request_deadline_general.reason: Every active registered California voter is mailed a ballot, and the Secretary of State sets no deadline to request one. It lists October 27, 2026 only as a recommended date to ask for a replacement ballot.

early_voting_window_general.reason: No single statewide start date: early voting sites opened October 5, 2026, and vote centers in Voter's Choice Act counties open October 24 or October 31 depending on the county.

primary_status.note: The primary has been held. The November ballot lists every candidate on the state's certified list; the primary results are on the state's official site.
